Commentary.Commentary: Different game but the same old story. Another dismal performance from the visitors and a huge victory for the hosts. Sri Lanka once again continued to disappoint with the bat in the third successive ODI and paid the price as they lost the series. Now, it's the matter of pride and their young guns would look to grab this opportunity and make a big name for themselves in the upcoming ODIs. South Africa on the other hand will be relieved as they have clinched the series. de Villiers in the post-match presentation said they might give a chance to some new faces, let's see who they shall be. The fourth ODI takes place in Cape Town on 7th February. The action begins at 1330 local (1130 GMT). Do join us! Till then, take care! Cheers!

Man of the Match, Dwaine Pretorius says that he is glad that he could perform for his team. With all his team-mates, fellow bowlers backing him up, he was very happy out there. Adds that he is glad that he could contribute for his team's victory as they march on from strength-to-strength. Ends up by saying that he is delighted that the short ball ploy worked on which he has been working.

South Africa skipper, AB de Villiers is delighted with today's performance. Says they couldn't score more than 300 or entertain the crowd by hitting the sixes but they have done the job of winning the series. Emphasizes on the cause (breast cancer) for which they played the game. Further says everyone did the job but credit to the bowlers to bowl out Sri Lanka under 200 as anything above it could have been tough to chase down. Is happy with his batting performance today as he got some runs under the belt. On the bees, he says that was annoying and accepts one can't control it. Opines that things like this takes the focus off but his team didn't lose it and did well. Ends by saying, they wanted to seal the series today itself so that they can have a word with the selectors now and give a chance to a couple of new faces in upcoming dead rubbers.

Sri Lanka skipper, Upul Tharanga begins by saying they got a good start and feels they couldn't capitalize on it. Credits Dickwella for the way he played but unfortunately lacked support from the other end. Adds he has no complaints from the bowling department as his bowlers gave their 200 percent and is happy with their efforts. Ends by saying, now that they have lost the series, they would focus on batting which is their main concern for the remaining games.

It was a decent bowling performance from the Islanders but they didn't have runs on board to work with neither did their fielders back them up. Amla and de Villiers, both were dropped and much to their dismay some half chances either fell short or in the no man's land which sums up the misery of the Lankans.

This led way for their skipper to walk in. He walked in, looked a bit uncertain at the start but then combined well with Amla. He remained true to his Pink ODI record as he belted his 49th ODI fifty and took it upon him to get the job done. After Amla got run out, Duminy came in the middle and ensured that there was no further hiccups. He stitched an unbeaten 72-run stand with his skipper and took his team across the finish line.

South Africa maintain their Pink ODI record of winning and also clinch the series! Apart from this, they are on a 12-match winning streak in ODIs at home, this is some feat to conquer. A record that is tumbled after 1997! The hosts once again bowled out Sri Lanka for a paltry score of 163. Chasing such a small total, the Proteas were pushed back as debutant Kumara got rid of de Kock early. However, the two experienced men, Amla and du Plessis scored at a good rate before the latter departed rather cheaply to another debutant, Madushanka.
There it is! Loopy ball outside off, AB de Villiers milks it down to long on and completes the single. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 7 WICKETS AND TAKE THE SERIES 3-0!
Floats it up around middle, Duminy turns it towards mid-wicket for a single. The scores are level!
Loopy ball around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short again and around off, punched towards sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! Half tracker and gets the treatment! Drops it short around middle, de Villiers camps back and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket. There was a man in the deep but could do nothing about it. SA just one hit away from a victory.
Around middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.
Dhanajaya de Silva comes into the attack now!
Floats it up outside off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Loopy ball around middle and off, defended down into the ground.
On the pads, worked through the leg side for a single.
Loopy ball around off, driven through covers for a single.
Flatter one around off, Duminy gets back and dabs it down to third man for a single.
On the pads, flicked away on the leg side for a single. 13 runs more needed!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Played off the back foot back to the bowler.
Short delivery, Duminy mistimes his square cut into the ground to point.
Wide! Wide outside off, Duminy leaves it. Wide signalled!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Landed outside off, de Villiers gets across and looks to to scoop but misses. Gets rapped up on the pads.
Duminy gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it.
FOUR! Duminy goes back and slaps this through covers for a boundary. Nicely done!
On leg, spinning away, AB looks to play it across the line. Gets squared up and the ball goes off the leading edge to covers for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, eased onto long on for a single.
Duminy gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it.
49th ODI fifty for AB de Villiers.
Short delivery, spinning away, AB backs away and punches it through covers for a single. Gets to his half century. This also brings 50-run partnership between de Villiers and Duminy.
Duminy charges down and pads it away on the leg side. 23 runs more needed to win!
Sliding into the pads, played through mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short delivery, punched back to the bowler.
Tossed up in the line of stumps, de Villiers shuffles and kneels down to sweep through backward square leg for a brace.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a double.
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Angling into de Villiers, mistimes his shot to mid-wicket.
Fired in the blockhole, AB digs it out back to the bowler. Is lucky to get bat on ball.
Tossed up on off, eased on to long on for a single.
Shortish delivery, worked through square leg off the back foot for a single.
Sliding down leg, AB misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up outside off, Duminy remains composed in defence.
FOUR! Duminy charges down, takes the ball on full and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They manage to come back for the second.

Tough chance but dropped! Spinning away from de Villiers. He steps down the track and looks to drive. Gets it off the outside edge. Tharanga at first slip dives to his right, gets a hand to it but fails to hold onto it. A single is taken!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shortish delivery, punched off the back foot to deep point for a single.
Lakshan Sandakan is back on!
Spinning down leg, flicked off the pads on the leg side for a single. 39 needed more now!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, spinning away, pushed to covers for a single.
FOUR! Fuller in the line of stumps, AB gets across and sweeps it away. Gets it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Fires it in, in the blockhole, dug out back to the bowler.
Shortish delivery outside off, spinning away, de Villiers looks to pull it but it's a touch wide. Drags it past short mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller length delivery outside off, pushed to covers.
Banged in short, angling away, Duminy jumps and looks to pull but misses it completely.

Fullish delivery around off, angling in, de Villiers looks to drive it with a straight bat. The ball nips is and goes off the inside edge onto the pads and to third man behind. Kumara is appealing for lbw and is the only one appealing. It's turned down. A single taken!
Wide! Down the leg side, AB looks to to tickle it but it's way down the leg side. Wide signalled!
FOUR! Short delivery angling in, de Villiers stays tall and pulls it from right under his eyes. Pulls it hard past mid on for a boundary. Great shot that!
Full toss, worked through mid-wicket for a single. Doesn't want to take any risk there, not even on a full toss!
Length delivery outside off, angling further away, tapped off the back foot to covers.
Tossed up on leg, eased on to long on for a single.
On leg, spinning away, defended back to the bowler.
Change of bat for Duminy here as Parnell comes running in with a few...
Outside off, de Villiers stays back and punches it through covers for a single.
Tossed up around off, AB shuffles and sweeps it to the man at square leg.
Served outside off, spinning away, de Villiers gets across, kneels down and sweeps it against the turn through mid-wicket. Gets a couple for it.
Wide! Down the leg side, ABD looks to clip it on its way but misses. A wide is signalled.
Tossed up delivery outside off, eased on to long on for a single.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, Duminy gets across, jumps and nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Wide outside off, AB bends his knees and slaps it through covers for a single.
Wide! Wayward delivery! Banged in shirt, angling down leg. It's wide down the leg side as well as for the height. First bouncer signalled!
Length delivery angling in, punched with the angle to mid on.
Fuller on the pads, clipped through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another play and a miss! Short angling away, Duminy gets on his toes and looks to guide it over the slip cordon but fails to make any contact.
Length delivery angling away, JP looks to cut it but the ball whistles past the top edge of the bat.
Short delivery, de Villiers tries to cut but mistimes it into the ground to covers.
On the pads, JP gets back and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Duminy defends this outside leg delivery, back to the bowler.
Outside leg, spinning away, defended off the front foot back to the bowler.
Outside off, pushed through covers for a single.

Served outside off, spinning in, JP prods forward and dabs it to point. There is slight hesitation from JP but AB is clear with his intent and is running at the danger end. In the end single is completed with ease.
Fuller on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. JP is off the mark.
Length ball on off, Duminy pushes it to point.

Top edge... safe! Chandimal can't get to the ball! Kumara comes steaming in and hits the deck hard, it shoots off the deck as de Villiers looks to pull. He goes on with the shot and ends up getting a thick top edge towards the leg side. Chandimal runs to his left and dives to take it but the ball falls in the safe zone near square leg. de Villiers survives and crosses over.

Fuller in length and around middle, de Villiers stays in the crease and drives it firmly towards mid on. The fielders misfields as the ball hits him and deflects towards mid off but still they don't take a run.
Outside off, it's left alone by AB.
Fuller in length and outside off, de Villiers drills it through covers. The sweeper cover comes spritning to his right and saves two for his side.
Lahiru Kumara is back into the attack!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter one outside off, punched through the line towards covers for a single.
JP Duminy is the new man in.

OUT! Run Out! Amla is short of his ground! Drops it short and outside off, de Villiers gets back and slaps it towards sweeper cover. They take the single but Amla wants another one as well. The debutant, Lahiru Madushanka in the deep fires in a throw at the bowler's end. It's a good one to Pathirana, who collects and whips the bails off as Amla dives to get back in. The Lankans are up and running but the umpire take it upstairs. Replays show Amla is well short and will have to make the long way back to the pavilion.
Run out appeal against Amla has been referred upstairs.
Loopy ball around off, Amla pushes it through backward point for a single.
Floats it up around off, Hashim pushes it towards point and wanted a single but won't get it.
Slower through the air around off, Amla goes back and tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
Sachith Pathirana to roll his arms.
Back of a length ball outside off, Amla punches it through covers to keep strike.
Shortish and angling on the hips, AB whips it off his hips down to fine leg for a single.
On the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Lofted down the ground! Madushanka once again gets this one to angle in, Amla presses forward and lofts it with a full flourish of the bat past the non-striker down to long on. Sandakan from mid on gives it a chase and tries to stop the ball with his foot but fails to do so.
Fuller in length and on the pads, whipped through mid-wicket for a single.

In the air... gone! Angles in a length ball around middle, de Villiers walks down the track to chip it away on the leg side but probably is deceived by the pace on the ball. The ball lobs towards mid on but falls well short of the man there.
Floated ball around off, Amla presses forward and defends it down into the ground.
Tossed up around off, knocked down to long on for one.
Driven towards the mid-on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
De Villiers once again brings out the sweep shot. He is targeting the short boundaries but there is a protection out in the deep. A single taken.
On middle and leg, it's worked fine down the leg side for a couple.

FOUR! A free gift on offer! Sandakan bowls a loopy full toss on middle and as my colleague says, Abraham Benjamin de Villiers won't miss out on these even in his sleep. Gets down on his rear knee and sweeps it neatly through backward square leg for a rocketing boundary.
Shortish outside off, Amla looks to slash it but fails to get any bat on it.
Angles in a length ball on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller in length on off, AB drives it back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, de Villiers pulls it through mid-wicket. Some good work in the deep means he will have to settle for a couple.
Fuller in length and angling in, de Villiers mistimes his drive towards mid on.
Good length ball on middle, Amla gets across and tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A googly around off, Amla taps it towards covers and scampers through for a quick single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Loops it outside off, it's very full, AB drives it towards covers where the fielder dives to his left to stop the run.
Tossed up around middle, bunted back to the bowler.

FOUR! Swept away nicely! There was an elemet of risk involved though. Loopy ball around middle and leg, de Villiers gets down on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg neatly to find the fence. Could have been in trouble had he missed it but not on this occasion. He earns a boundary this time.
Fuller outside leg, flicked straight to short fine leg.
Drinks time! SA need only 101 more with 8 wickets in hand!
Fuller and strayed on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket by de Villiers for a single to get off the mark.
Good length ball outside off, Amla comes forward, opens the face and runs it down to third man for a single.
A length ball outside off, punched towards the cover fielder.
Stays behind to this length delivery and defends it back to the bowler.
Leg bye! Slips it down the leg side, de Villiers gets across to flick but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye picked up.
On a length and outside off, moving away nicely as AB taps it towards the point region.
Loopy delivery around leg, nudged towards the leg side. A good over, just a couple off it.
Flatter and shorter outside off, punched off the back foot to mid off.
This one turns in sharply, Amla moves away and mistimes it back to Sandakan.
Full and around off, driven hard but finds the cover fielder.
Around off, turning in, Amla prods forward in defense.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, worked away through mid-wicket. They look for another one but de Villiers is quick to get back in.
Spin is introduced as Lakshan Sandakan has the ball in his hands.
Touch short and around off, punched straight to short cover.
AB de Villiers is the new man in.

OUT! Madushanka strikes in his very first over! Scalps his maiden ODI wicket and boy, he is all pumped up. Lets out a huge roar. Fuller in length and moving a bit, du Plessis looks to flick it across the line but ends up getting a leading edge towards point. De Silva stationed there tries to take a reverse cup catch, fumbles but does well to grab it on the second attempt. Faf departs cheaply tonight. 106 required off 129 deliveries!
Good length ball outside off, pushed towards point.
Driven nicely past covers for an easy single.
Fuller and angling in from around off, Amla looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards covers.
Fuller in length and swings after pitching, Amla has got nothing to do with it.
Lahiru Madushanka to bowl his first ODI over.
Outside off, Faf lets it go through to the keeper.
FOUR! Powerfully done! A length ball outside off, du Plessis stays back and punches it ever so powerfully past the man at extra cover to find the fence.
Walks across the sticks and works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
A harmless length ball outside off, Amla doesn't play at it.
Gets across a long way and looks to tuck it away but misses and gets hit on the pads as the ball rolls towards the leg side. They look to cross but then decide against it.
On a good length and straightens a bit after landing, Amla nicely lifts his bat to let it be.
Powerplay 2 signalled! Max 4 fielders allowed outside the circle now.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Faf defends by getting on his toes.
Length delivery angling in, FdP stays in his crease and defends it.
FOUR! Full outside off, du Plessis creams his drive through covers for a boundary.
Angling down leg, tickled behind square on the leg side for a single.
Banged in short, Amla ducks under it.
FOUR! Down the ground! Full outside off, Amla just middles it down the ground through mid off for a boundary.
That just skidded through! Full outside off, du Plessis leaves it. It's a good leave as the ball just zipped through after pitching.
Back of a length delivery outside off, FdP gets on his toes and taps it to covers.
Pitched on middle and off, du Plessis stays back, gives himself some room to defend gently near the pitch. Looks for a single but Amla isn't interested.
Length delivery angling in, defended with the angle to mid-wicket.
Amla literally walks across and nudges it through to fine leg for a single.
On a length outside off, rises a touch extra, defended off the outer half of the bat to covers.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On a length outside off, Faf covers his stumps and defends it from within the crease.

Lbw appeal turned down! Angling into Faf, he looks to play ti across the line but fails to get the bat down in time as the ball nips back in sharply. There's a loud appeal for lbw but it's turned down. Going down leg maybe!
Full outside off, driven past point. The third man fielder cuts it out and keeps it down to two.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, fended to mid on for a single.

Length delivery angling in, nips back in too, du Plessis looks to play it off the back foot on the leg side but the inward movement surprises him. Gets it off the inner half of the bat to square leg for a single.
Good length ball on the pads, it's flicked straight to the man at square leg. It's a maiden over from Lakmal, could have been a wicket maiden had Chandimal not dropped a catch.
In the channel outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Angles in a length ball around off, HA hangs back and offers a straight bat defense.
Short of a length ball outside off, Amla gets on top of the bounce and cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Fuller and wide outside off, this time Hashim doesn't offer any stroke.

Edged and dropped! Chandimal the culprit! Lakmal hurls in a length ball around off, it shapes away a touch after pitching. Amla feels for it and as a result goes after it. Gets a thick edge that flies to the right of the keeper who dives full length but the ball doesn't stick. Should have been taken, SL can't afford to drop such chances.
Defence off the back foot to end the over!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Faf shuffles across and touch and punches it on the up to covers.
Fullish delivery outside off, Amla pushes it past bowler. The mid off fielder dives across to his right and stops it.
Angling in, flicked to mid-wicket.
Short delivery, pulled on the leg side for a single.
On a length outside off, du Plessis covers his line and defends it back to the bowler.
Another leave by Amla to end the over.
Pitched outside off, Amla covers his stumps and leaves it.
Wide! Wide outside off, it's too wide and Amla leaves it. A wide is signalled.
Length delivery outside off, tapped in covers. The covers fielder half-stops and allows the batsman to complete the single.
On a length, nips back in after pitching, du Plessis gets his bat down in time and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Shortish delivery, angling in, du Plessis pulls it over square leg. Doesn't time it well but well enough to clear the infield and gets it to the boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
Down the leg side, nudged it fine down leg for a single. He will keep the strike!
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
SIX! Top edged over the ropes! Kumara welcomes du Plessis with a short delivery, he pulls but mistimes it. The ball goes off the top edge over the keeper's head for a maximum. Unlucky there, Kumara!
Faf du Plessis walks in next! Huge cheer from the crowd as this is his 100th ODI. This feeling would be totally different.

OUT! WICKET ON DEBUT FOR KUMARA! De Kock doesn't get so lucky now! Back of a length delivery, angling across, de Kock gets on his toes and looks to defend it off the back foot. Gets an inside edge which goes on to clip the top of middle and leg. Kumara is delighted to have his man! This will get the Lankans going!

NOT OUT! DECISION OVERTURNED! Fullish delivery on leg, nips back in a touch into the southpaw, keeps low as well. De Kock looks to flick it but misses and is rapped up on the pads. Kumara turns back to appeal for an LBW and the umpire raises his finger. Amla straightaway tells de Kock to take the review and he does. It proves out to be an excellent decision as the Hawk Eye shows that the ball had pitched just outside leg. That is enough to overturn the decision! De Kock survives!

Quinton de Kock is given out LBW by Kettleborough! The South African keeper takes the review as Hashim Amla from the other end asks him to. Is there an inside edge? Is it pitched outside leg? Let's wait and find out...
On the hips, flicked through backward square leg. There's a fumble in the deep which allows the batsman to take a couple.
Pitched outside off, Amla shoulders his arms.
On a length outside off, defended off the back foot.
FOUR! Amla shuffles a long way across and tickles this back of a length delivery fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery, aimed at body, de Kock looks to drag it but mistimes it in the air, just past Sandakan at short fine leg. Gets a single!
FOUR! Pulled away! Back of a length delivery, de Kock latches onto it in a flash as he pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
A touch shorter on leg, angling cross, defended from within the crease.
Amla ends the over with a solid front foot defence. A long over, 10 deliveries bowled in it!
Full outside off, pushed on the up to covers.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Wide! Sprays this one down the leg side, Amla leaves it again. Another wide one!
Outside off, left alone!
Wide! Angling down leg, another leave and another wide delivery.
FOUR! Amla puts this Free Hit away! Full outside off, in the slot, Amla clears his front leg and frees his arms. Goes inside out over covers and gets a boundary for it.
Another wayward delivery, angling down leg, Amla leaves it. But, it's signalled no ball as Kumara overstepped there!
Wide! Down the leg side, Amla leaves it. Wide is signalled!
Full outside off, shaping away, HA leans and just pushes it through the gap between mid off and covers. Earns a couple for it.
Lahiru Kumara to bowl from the other end.
On the shorter side of the length, defended off the back foot by QdK.
De Kock stays in his crease and blocks it by getting on the toes.
On a length and angling across, de Kock shuffles a touch and defends on the leg side.
Length delivery outside off, Amla shimmies and guides it through backward point for a single.

Edged but safe! Back of a length delivery, angling across, de Kock looks to pull it but is early into his shot. The ball goes off the leading edge over covers. The covers fielder tries his best to get a hand onto it but can't reach to it even with a dive. A single taken!
Back of a length delivery, angling away, defended to mid-wicket.
Welcome back for the chase! Hashim Amla and Quinton de Kock come out to open for South Africa. It shall be Suranga Lakmal to steam in first up. Let's play...
